_comment: Accepted/known accessibility debt for the Upgrades tab. scripts/check_layout_gate.py and scripts/check_tab_review.py pass this file to the fork's test-layout.mjs / test-review.mjs via TBC_A11Y_BASELINE, so these are tracked debt and only NEW critical/serious WCAG violations block. Every entry carries EITHER a ticket (a fix is owed) OR a wontfix reason. An entry that no longer fires prints a stale-baseline WARN and should be removed, unless it carries "mayNotFire": true: that marks debt the gate's capture may not show, prints no stale-baseline WARN, and its reason must say why. Match "css" compares the selector's [attr=value] and .class parts with the attributes of the node axe reports (test-tab-harness.mjs a11yClassify). Re-derived for the React tab by ticket 560 (stage 558-p3-settings-gates, K5) from what test-layout.mjs (feral-p3-p2bis, 375/653/768/1280, pre-run and post-run) and test-review.mjs (manifest review-560.json: settings column, Sources dialog, view toggles, below-cutoff group) measured at fork b3e50d8e0 and its K5 successors: no color-contrast violation fires on the React tab, so the old tab's two entries (color-contrast on .upgrades-item-name.text-epic, ticket 473, and .text-rare, ticket 480; both tickets closed) were removed -- their class selectors cannot match the React DOM, whose item name carries data-testid=upgrades-item-name. If a later fixture shows a contrast finding on an item-quality colour, add it here with its selector and the measurement.

entries.reason: wontfix in the tab: the below-cutoff group's header is the <h6> that upstream's ui-kit AccordionItem renders (ui/ui-kit/Accordion/AccordionItem.tsx, render={<h6 />}), with no heading-level prop, and ui-kit is upstream code the tab does not edit (ticket 560 plan, Paths manifest). axe impact moderate, so it is a warning, never a failure; baselined so the warning names its reason (ticket 560, Gate C K4 amendments A-K4-group-head and A-K4-a11y).
